fusions.name: Table Thief
fusions.desc: A snatching weapon strike that deals 7 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Bolt It Down
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health: a gorging bite deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. You regain 10 health and move 30% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Full Cheeks
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds and 10 health at once, and scampers you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Crumb Hoard
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you heal for 1% of your maximum health per stack (10% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
